XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure of the parking assistance system to warn of obstacles behind the vehicle
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | ADAS | B107C | BUZZER | SIGNALLING | ACOUSTIC | AUDIBLE | BUMPER | SENSORS | DETECTION | ASSISTANCE | LOUDSPEAKER | WARNING | ALERT | MANOEUVRE | REVERSE GEAR |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: ADAS

  • Device: Rear parking warning buzzer

  • Fault: During parking manoeuvres, no audible warning is given for the presence of rear obstacles; when reverse gear is engaged, a general hazard warning light comes on

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: B107C (Parking system buzzer fault)

  • Cause: Rear warning buzzer defective

• Action: Replace the rear warning buzzer

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: The rear warning buzzer is located in the boot, on the passenger side, above the right rear seat belt retractor.
    After replacing the rear warning buzzer, no reprogramming via diagnostics is necessary.
